page.eyebrow: PoC · on the floor or on the wall
page.title: Put each room object on the floor or on the wall
page.lead: A room of a fictional course, already in the new size: 18 m walls and the door near the corner. Each video totem and each board can be on a wall or standing on the floor (a board on the floor becomes a notice sign on a pedestal). Each wall takes up to 5 boards, counting boards and totems together; what is on the floor does not count. Change it in the editor below and publish: the room only changes if there is no problem.
